notes.title: GACHI FINDER 3000 ACHIEVEMENT AND QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]GACHI FINDER 3000 ACHIEVEMENT AND QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATE[/b]

I know it's been a while, but I felt this needed to happen before losing this project to time. Thank you all for the support of this game and the amazing reviews. I always felt that when this game was originally developed I could not live up to my own expectations and released something with many glaring flaws. I hope that you can forgive me and enjoy getting the new achievements. The small changes I made fixed many of the audio issues and paused abuse that existed before, do enjoy the update! 
________________________________________________________________________
Here are some of the changes made!

---General Updates---
-Some leaderboard scores have been reset

---Features---
-Blur added to pause screen ( no more peaking! )
-Music now fades into each song change
-All volume sliders are larger

---BUG FIXES---
-volume sliders show correct volume settings on level start
-volume sliders affect sound effects volume as well as music
-Audio Settings Save Correctly
-Audio Settings Cross Over Scenes Correctly
